query: For every product in records.json, use its published title, attributes, price, currency and marketplace categories with frozen HTS 2025 Revision 15 to return one 10-digit HTS code as a singleton string list. Consult hierarchy, unnumbered parent rows and full notes. Do not assume price is per item, invent photos, convert currency without evidence, or reconstruct missing product facts. If a supported classification cannot be completed, ABSTAIN with null value and a concrete reason. The source-label task supplies no independent UNKNOWN gold.
note: DEVELOPMENT_INCOMPLETE_INPUT_DIAGNOSTIC；本地派生任务，非原benchmark官方查询；没有模型执行或K测量。独立专家10位码；前缀目标由同一标签派生
